title: Do You Give 'Pity Likes'?
description: Are your likes genuine, polite, or calculated? Find out your social media personality.

questions.text: You see a friend's post with 0 likes after 2 hours. You...

choices.label: Like it to make them smile!
Like it because 0 likes looks too sad.
Like it so they'll like my next post.
Ignore it. Not my problem.

questions.text: Someone posts a really bad selfie. What do you do?

choices.label: "Cute!" *Likes instantly*
*Likes* out of secondhand embarrassment.
*Likes* to maintain the connection.
Scroll past. I only like good content.

questions.text: What is your main reason for hitting "Like"?

choices.label: To spread positivity.
To avoid feeling guilty.
To keep my social network active.
To genuinely appreciate great content.

questions.text: A distant acquaintance starts a new online shop.

choices.label: Share and like everything to support them!
Like one post so I don't look mean.
Like it so they might buy my stuff later.
Only like if the product is actually good.

questions.text: What is your golden rule for commenting?

choices.label: Hype them up with lots of emojis!
Just a quick "Nice" so I'm not ignoring them.
Comment only if it boosts my visibility.
Only comment if I have something meaningful to add.
